verdict.rationale: Community users report that Hoppscotch works without a login (comm-4) and that an offline mode exists, though limited to a single workspace with no way to point workspace data at a local directory (comm-5). First-party evidence covers only the delivery vehicles: an installable PWA, a cross-platform desktop app and a no-install web client (gh-7, docs-27, docs-29, docs-13). None of it explicitly documents offline-first local workspaces. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing offline/local-only workspace operation, multiple offline workspaces, file-system-backed workspace storage.
